literature.work: MemSAM: Taming Segment Anything Model for Echocardiography Video Segmentation, CVPR 2024
literature.overlap: Predicted-mask-conditioned memory reinforcement before a memory update, using a downsampled mask concatenated with features and Conv3x3/Conv1x1 processing.
literature.difference: This adaptation adds a zero-initialized residual to features entering SAM2's unchanged native MemoryEncoder; it does not transfer MemSAM weights or reproduce its final mask-gated working-memory value.

literature.work: Recurrent Dynamic Embedding for Video Object Segmentation, CVPR 2022
literature.overlap: Addresses error from imperfect predicted masks and memory embeddings.
literature.difference: Uses embedding self-correction with mask-consistency supervision; the current candidate does not use that loss or replace the memory bank.

literature.work: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
literature.overlap: SAM2 already transforms predicted mask probabilities and supplies them to its MemoryEncoder.
literature.risk: The added soft-mask cue may be redundant or amplify prediction errors.

method_claim_boundary: Mask-conditioned memory writing is established prior art. This study evaluates a specific residual-write adaptation to SAM2, not a claim to invent mask-conditioned memory or prove semantic purity of token vectors.
